evidence: REVIEWED — 3 findings, all in this ticket's own code, all fixed and re-verified. Full write-up at .autodev/evidence/T-2/review.md. Three further items considered and deliberately left with reasons recorded: per-call connections, import-time bootstrap, and start.sh's grep/cut .env read.
